description: A real (non-`--dry-run`) `add <path>` appends the `[projects.<name>]` block to the resolved config file on disk — never rewrites the rest of it (`_cmd_add_locked`'s own docstring: 'Appends; never rewrites') — and prints the identical text under an `Added to ...:` header instead of `Would append to ...:`. The appended chain uses the role's current config key (`scout`, not the retired `explorer`), because this block is read straight back by the next `multiverse check`/`dispatch` — a retired key here made that next command refuse the file this one had just written. `expect_tree` here only covers project roots (the config file lives under `{{STATE_DIR}}`/`{{HOME}}`, which `expect_tree`'s `root` cannot target), so the written config itself is checked only by inference from the printed `Added to ...:` block, not a direct file-content assertion — the companion `add-dry-run-prints-block` scenario pins the identical block-building logic without this real write.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-a]
kind = "codex"
short = "sa"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:a"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"
